title: Infotainment System Setup
summary: Feedback in this topic is mostly favorable toward the G60 infotainment system, while the limited non-positive examples point to setup complexity or provide too little detail to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the infotainment system as a standout feature owners especially love, though the examples provide little detail beyond strong approval.

mixed.summary: The mixed feedback says the multimedia or infotainment setup feels overly complicated.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention limited interaction with the infotainment system or suggest it could be improved without enough detail to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: The sampled positive examples are highly repetitive and give little concrete detail about specific infotainment features or setup strengths.
Only one mixed example is provided, so the range of concrete pain points is insufficiently detailed.
A substantial portion of examples are undetermined, which limits clarity about specific user experiences with the system.
